description: Look up a business by its phone number and get its Odile Direct card. Use this first: send_to_business needs the business id from this card. Returns {agent_card, business, trade, town}; agent_card is the A2A card URL (/b/<biz>/ for a business line, /c/<biz>/ for a claimed listing; pass that <biz> to send_to_business) and the card lists the skills the business accepts. A number that is not on Direct returns not_found with claim_url and listings_url; for a US/Canada number, voice_fallback explains whether call_business is available. Free: 30/IP/hour without sign-in; 10000/key/day signed in. Read-only; contacts no business.

number.description: The business's phone number in E.164, e.g. +15615550123.
